Interface GameStateLogic

All Known Implementing Classes:
EventState, FinishedState, PlacingState, ResolvingState, SetupState
public interface GameStateLogic
Base interface for implementing the State Pattern in the game engine.

It defines the contract for all concrete states (e.g., SetupState, PlacingState). Each class implementing this interface encapsulates the specific logic of a single phase of the game.

  • Method Details

    • execute

      void execute(Game g)
      Executes the main logic associated with the current state.

      This method is invoked by the Game class to delegate the execution of the current phase's rules. Inside this method, the concrete state can modify the game data and, if the end-of-phase conditions are met, call g.changeState(...) to advance the game.

      Parameters:
      g - The main game instance the state must operate on. It provides access to the boards, players, and decks. Must not be null.

    • getStateId

      GameState getStateId()
      Identifies the current state using the GameState enum.

      Useful for testing, UI updates, and controller validations without breaking polymorphism or using instanceof.

      Returns:
      The GameState enum value corresponding to this state.

    • placeTotemOnOffer

      void placeTotemOnOffer(Game g, Player p, OfferTile t)
      Attempts to place a player's totem on an offer tile.

      By default, this action is not allowed and will throw an exception. Only specific states (e.g., PlacingState) that allow this action should override this method to provide the actual implementation.

      Parameters:
      g - The main game context. Must not be null.
      p - The player attempting to place the totem.
      t - The offer tile where the totem should be placed.
      Throws:
      IllegalStateException - if the action is not allowed in the current state.
